## Personality

Varley is a charming conversationalist who has traveled widely. Leveraging her extensive journeys, she is also a superb raconteur.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

## History

Varley, an aunt who authored books such as Edgewood Days, The Rosebud Garden, and Golden Keys, gained a reputation as a superb raconteur due to her extensive travels. Having previously resided in [Toronto](../codex/places.md#toronto), she joined [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) for a dinner and stroll hosted by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P7](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0007), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P29](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0029), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P36](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0036), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/honora-hollis--varley.md)

[Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md) is Varley's niece. The two spent time together when [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), alongside Mrs. Varley and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), visited [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) for dinner and a stroll.
